name: audit-orchestrator
description: Universal software security audit orchestrator (Universal Audit Multiagent v3.0). Use proactively when asked to "audit this repository", "run a full security audit", "look for vulnerabilities, backdoors, LGPD issues, supply chain, infrastructure or AI problems in this project". Runs the preflight (scope, authorization, read-only), inventory, threat model and tasks across the 20 domains; dispatches the specialized auditors; requires output in the agent-result contract; runs gate G2 (audit_contracts.py); sends the candidates to the audit-evidence-validator in an independent context and only...
